parse.title: Items
parse.text:
Items are used in various ways to help boost the player and their units. They're obtainable from every game mode.

  • XP Items
  • Portals
  • Materials
  • Keys
  • Misc. Items
  • Boosts

XP Items are used to be fed to units, which will give them XP if they aren't already at the max unit level. You're able to hold a maximum of 1000 of each XP Food.

Portals page
Item
Information
Frozen Portal
 Used to opened a portal to a special stage
Completing frozen worlds during Christmas 2022 event. Receiving the next tier portal or the random (same or lower) tier portal.
Frost Queen's Portal
 Used to opened a portal to a special stage
Completing frozen worlds in Tier 3 and above during Christmas 2022 event, the higher the tier, the higher chances. Chances are doubled if you happen to be the host.
Devil Portal
 Used to opened a portal to a special stage
Obtained by purchasing Devil Contract (Rank 0-5) from talking to a NPC Makimo.
Alien Portal
 Used to opened a portal to a special stage
Received from a random drop in Alien Spaceship infinite mode.
Alien King's Portal
 Used to opened a portal to a special stage
Received from a drop in Alien Spaceship (Final) with a low chance. Chances are doubled if you happen to be the host.
Demon Leader's Portal
 Used to to opened a portal to a special stage
Received from clearing Act 1/2/3 of Legend Stage Fabled Kingdom (Ten Commandments) (20% chance) or dropped from Sunshine Demons (guaranteed, but Sunshine Demons spawns at unknown chance).
Puppet Island Portal (Bird Cage)
 Used to opened a portal to a special stage
Received from a drop in Puppet Islands in Infinity Mode.
Puppet Island Portal (Secret Portal)
 Used to opened a portal to a special stage
Completing Puppet Island Portal (Bird Cage) with an extremely low chance. Chances are doubled if you happen to be the host.
Eclipse Portal
 Used to opened a portal to a special stage
Received from a drop in Windhym in Infinity Mode.
King's Portal (Secret Portal)
 Used to opened a portal to a special stage
Completing Eclipse Portal with an extremely low chance. Chances are doubled if you happen to be the host.
Summer Portal
 Used to opened a portal to a special stage
Received by completing summer worlds during Summer 2023 event or bought for 200 Gems at Summer Event shop.
Noble Portal
 Used to opened a portal to a special stage
Received from a drop in Mountain Temple Infinity Mode.
Golden Portal (Secret Portal)
 Used to opened a portal to a special stage
Completing Noble Portal with a very low chance. Chances are doubled if you happen to be the host, and chances are increased if you have Update 17 units equipped.
